dedupe_keys.name: 2021 electricity and heat demand data for a city district belgium

description: Chaïm De Mulder of OpenMotics and DuCoop publishes fifteen-minute electricity and heat-demand measurements for a Belgian city district in 2021. The electricity tables separate households, EV charging, wastewater treatment, a heat pump, district-heating pumps, vacuum-network pumps and other uses. Separate measured and calculated totals are provided. Heat demand aggregates private units and shared facilities. Zenodo lists three CSV files released in January 2022, free under CC BY-NC 4.0. The district was still under construction and partly unoccupied, which limits transfer to a fully operating neighbourhood. Aggregate electricity and heat units change from kilowatts before 6 June to watts afterwards; household electricity remains in watts. The named district and missing-data rates are unknown. These observations can calibrate coupled local energy-service simulations. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
